text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—
This scent never fails
to take me back to that place.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A garden steeped in sweet fragrance—
where noble flowers stand proud and dignified...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I must prove it—the pride running through my veins.
I must claim victory—for the long-cherished dream of the Rose Clan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall seize a glory worthy of this noble fragrance—and of the name 'Kingdom'.
By any means necessary. ...Without fail.
